international.title: UK government ‘breaking the law’ by not stopping decline of wild birds
international.summary: Populations at lowest level on record with 45% of native breeding species in decline, environment watchdog says The environment secretary, Angela Eagle, her ministers and Natural England are breaking the law by failing to intervene to slow the “deeply concerning” decline of Britain’s wild birds, the UK’s environment regulator has said. New data shows that wild bird populations have dropped to their lowest level on record, with almost half – 45% – of 132 native breeding species in decline over a five-year period.
